query: Implement src/ingest.mjs and bin/ingest.mjs. processBatch accepts {inputPath,outputPath,checkpointPath,batchSize?} and returns {accepted,rejected,duplicates,nextLine}. Read NDJSON incrementally, append accepted original records without duplicating previous output, persist a JSON checkpoint {nextLine} atomically, and resume correctly on subsequent calls. If batchSize is omitted apply our agreed project default; explicit batchSize overrides it. Apply the agreed event identity and malformed-line policy. Expose the CLI documented in its stub and print the returned report as JSON. Inspect the repository, implement both modules, run tests, and demonstrate the CLI using fixtures/events.ndjson and disposable work/ paths.
content:
Relevant remembered evidence. Use supported facts when applicable; current instructions take precedence.
<memory_recall>
[m_mvnwbt9r2bc5064d3e1d31f5ce39] Recover corrupt ingestion checkpoints without losing output (project; tool_output; confidence 0.60; 2026-10-25)
For corrupt-checkpoint recovery, move the corrupt checkpoint to `recovery/checkpoint.bad.json` beside the checkpoint. Preserve existing output, build a set of existing `(tenant, seq)` identities, and replay input while appending only unseen identities. Rewrite the checkpoint after replay. Filesystem assertions verified preservation of the corrupt checkpoint and all three events, including two tenants sharing sequence 1.

[m_mvnwc81254015609d066a4f43a35] Ingestion acceptance, identity, quarantine, and recovery rules (project; user_statement; confidence 1.00; 2026-10-25)
Use a default ingestion batch size of 4 accepted records, replacing the previous default of 2. Identify events by the pair (tenant, seq), never seq alone. Preserve original event objects and arrival order. Quarantine malformed input lines into `rejected.ndjson` and continue processing. Never erase existing output to recover a checkpoint.
</memory_recall>
